canonical_edition: Vita Theodosii coenobiarchae (BHGn 1778b), e cod. Baltimorensi W.521, ed. F. Halkin, Le ménologe impérial de Baltimore, Subsidia hagiographica 69 (Brussels: Société des Bollandistes, 1985): 125–137; cf. CYRILLUS Biogr. 2877.005.
sources_tested: Exact BHG/title/edition searches; Digital Walters W.521 detailed contents and viewer; Pinakes BHG 1778b work and W.521 witness records; local licensed-corpus and scan-register checks; comparison with related Canon reference 2877.005.
open_text_result: No licensed open transcription of the precise BHG 1778b Imperial-Menologion recension was located. The related Cyril of Scythopolis reference and generic Metaphrastic versions were retained only as context, not substituted.
scan_result: Exact manuscript witness verified by Walters and Pinakes: W.521, fols. 70v–74v and 83r–85v. Fols. 75r–82v contain an intervening, incomplete Euthymius fragment, so the Theodosius item is discontinuous and must be represented as two sequences.
scan_rights: The Walters catalogue description is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 metadata. No image-manifest licence has been verified for either folio run; no image was fetched or queued.
next_action: Verify image-file licence in the W.521 manifest for both 70v–74v and 83r–85v. Only if explicitly project-compatible may both runs be transferred remotely; exclude 75r–82v as a different, incomplete text.
notes: The split witness is established from two independent catalogue records. No generic Theodosius work, third-party OCR, or local image was used.
